identity_binding: authenticated Core owner plus protected project registry; caller text is not authority
catalog_value_validation: SKU and fulfillment values are bounded exact printable catalog strings; Core does not pad, replace, normalize, or infer them
source_reference_validation: source_review_ref and correlation_ref are bounded exact printable source strings up to 200 characters, including an existing colon-separated namespace; Core does not fabricate a record ID or transform source spelling
blocker_validation: each unresolved_blockers entry is a bounded exact printable diagnostic string up to 500 characters; v1 preserves both machine-readable codes and human-readable policy text without an unapproved code/text remapping
receipt_recovery: internal-only owner/project/operation-bound lookup uses an original idempotency key plus exact original request identity against encrypted receipt storage; unavailable original record/revision history returns non-authoritative unknown, while present contradictory bindings reject; it never returns a raw key, request payload, inferred noncommit, or retry permission

invariants.idempotency: same authenticated owner project record kind and request fingerprint returns the original receipt; changed content conflicts
invariants.revisions: edits require the exact prior revision and append a linked revision; stale revisions reject
invariants.durability: record and receipt persist atomically in the encrypted Core snapshot; receipt recovery verifies the original create/revision binding, returns unknown when the required historical record or revision is unavailable, and rejects retained contradictory bindings rather than inferring noncommit or retry permission
invariants.reads: owner scoped, bounded, paginated and non-mutating; list, direct record and audit reads all enforce the current permitted-project policy
invariants.audit: record creation and revision append durable identifier-only audit events; audit reads are non-mutating, and production read-access capture requires a separate activation-time policy
invariants.authority: records never approve, assign, dispatch, execute, mutate, message a provider, create a Woo order, take payment or change inventory

activation_gates: protected project registry and required retention/access policy
authenticated route design and security review
acceptance: duplicate and concurrent submissions yield one record
restart preserves records and identifier-only create/revision audit events
no business mutation or approval promotion occurs
